headline: PM Tarique Rahman chairs meeting on easing traffic congestion and modernising management
summary: The Prime Minister held the third meeting of a dedicated committee to discuss strategies for reducing traffic jams and updating the traffic management system.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman chaired the third meeting focused on reducing traffic congestion and modernising the traffic management system.
The session took place this morning at the Public Administration Conference Room of the Cabinet Division in the Secretariat.
According to Prime Minister’s Deputy Press Secretary Jahidul Islam Rony, the meeting aimed to find sustainable solutions to the city's traffic woes.
The discussions centered on updating the current infrastructure and implementing more efficient management systems to ease themovements of citizens.

headline: Tk 14,000 crore allocated: Family Cards to target 4.1 crore families
summary: Finance Minister Amir Khosru Mahmud Chowdhury announces that the program will exclude wealthy individuals and be managed solely by government officials.
details: The government has allocated Tk 14,000 crore in the budget for the Family Card program, aimed at supporting millions of households.
Finance Minister Amir Khosru Mahmud Chowdhury stated that the program's list will be updated every four years to ensure that wealthy individuals are removed from the benefits.
A total of 41 million families are expected to be covered under this initiative, with funds being distributed directly into bank accounts via Sonali Bank's 'Taka Pay' app.

The Finance Minister emphasized that for the first time, no political party members will be involved in the implementation of a social program, as it will be managed exclusively by government officials.
Social Welfare Minister Dr. AZM Zahid Hossain noted that data collection is currently underway, though some challenges have emerged, such as the lack of SIM cards for some women.
To address this, the government has made provisions in the budget to provide free SIM cards to ensure all eligible beneficiaries can receive their payments.
